S H R I M A T A V A I S H N O D E V I U N I V E R S I T Y
Kakryal, Katra – 182320 (J&K)
(Ranked among top 100 Engineering & Management Intitutions and among
top 150 Universities in the NIRF 2019 ranking of MHRD, GoI.)
ADVERTISEMENT FOR JRF/SRF/RA POSITION
Applications are invited for position of JRF/SRF/RA at a fixed
fellowship of Rs. 31,000/-, Rs. 35,000/- & Rs. 47,000/- respectively in
a three years CSIR sponsored project titled, “A study of Orlicz
sequence spaces and their operators”. The other details including
eligibility conditions can be downloaded from the University website
at www.smvdu.ac.in . Application on plain paper including detailed
CV should be sent to Dr. Kuldip Raj, Assistant Professor, School of
Mathematics, SMVD University, Katra, J&K - 182320 within 15 days
from the date of publication of this advertisement in the hard copy
form or can be emailed to kuldeep.raj@smvdu.ac.in
SMVDU/R&D/19/583 Dated:18/9/2019 Sd/-Dr. Kuldip Raj, PI, RP-102
